source.provenance: Original built-in generated flat RGB artwork. Utility fields are numerical artist estimates, not scanned or measured optics.

color_preservation: Source/OpalOriginal.png and Textures/OpalColor.png preserve original PNG bytes exactly; no appearance editing.

authoring.segmentation: Connected chromatic patches from original artwork; binary antialias cleanup only, no appearance synthesis
authoring.domain_channels: R=actual connected chromatic patch coverage,G=source body value,B=nearest-domain family phase estimate
authoring.orientation: One deterministic normalized tilt per connected patch; broad families with neighboring-family influence; nearest-patch orientation extends through gaps without coverage multiplication
authoring.normal_convention: DirectX tangent normalize(slope_u,slope_v,1); original top-left image orientation; no green flip

limitations: Coverage, family phase and tilt are numerical artistic estimates, not calibrated mineral structure or optical scans.
Normals describe internal optical domains, not RGB brightness gradients or displaced surface geometry.
Nearest-domain orientation extension changes only numerical fields in gaps; appearance RGB remains unmodified.
Constant roughness .12 is represented by the nearest 8-bit value; outer polish normal is intentionally flat.
Native material response, visual quality and performance require separate real rendered verification.
